name: Octree-based out-of-core volume rendering
definition: An out-of-core rendering approach based on an octree structure, extending the single-channel method of Crassin et al. to support multiple visible channels by storing pointers and culling metadata in each node.
summary: Octree-based out-of-core volume rendering manages large datasets by storing pointers and culling metadata in an octree, enforcing whole-subtree residency for high-resolution rendering at the cost of higher memory usage.
